cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['21-22 Schedule']
for r in range(12,15):
    for c in range(2,13):
        if ws.cell(r,c).value is None:
            col = openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(c)
            ws.cell(r,c).value = '=IF({0}\$12={0}\$2,{0}\$2,IF({0}\$12={0}\$3,{0}\$3,IF({0}\$12={0}\$4,{0}\$4,IF({0}\$12={0}\$5,{0}\$5,IF({0}\$12={0}\$6,{0}\$6,IF({0}\$12={0}\$7,{0}\$7,IF({0}\$12={0}\$8,{0}\$8)))))))'.format(col)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
